purpose: VIRTURA Creation Network public-safe asset source manifest for SpacePort / Collective / future virtura.base web frontstage.

source_of_truth.notes: The current connector cannot create a new repository. This manifest should be copied or synced into the future web repo after it is created locally or via GitHub CLI.

public_boundary_rules: Only include VIRTURA-related team / collective / creation-network materials.
Do not include Xuan Spatial Perception / 玄空间感知 materials in this package.
TIMER / 控时者 and Drop Flow / 滴流 are VIRTURA-related collaborative works; do not imply sole authorship.
Missing Signals is Murphy's project; do not include as Ewan/VIRTURA representative material unless a separate collaboration boundary is explicitly approved.
Use KASHIWA Daisuke / 柏大辅. Do not use 博达福.
Use 徐昊, RÖ, Shukai / Mark where relevant.
Do not expose private process memory, unverified venue claims, private client files, or raw internal chat.

packages.title: Creation Network
packages.public_role: Team identity and collaboration network package.

copy.one_line_en: VIRTURA is a creation network for stage visuals, spatial screens, audiovisual systems, digital exhibitions, and AI-assisted production tools.
copy.one_line_zh: VIRTURA 是一个面向舞台视觉、空间屏幕、音画系统、数字展映与 AI 辅助制作工具的创作网络。
copy.short_zh: 它不是单一工作室官网，而是一个用于组织作品、音乐人合作、空间影像、数字展映、媒体包与工具实验的创作网络前台。

packages.title: Stage Visuals
packages.public_role: Live-ready visuals for concerts, performances, festivals, and experimental music contexts.
proof_projects: KASHIWA Daisuke / 柏大辅 related visual work

copy.one_line_zh: 面向音乐现场、演出空间、舞台屏幕和实验现场的视觉制作包。
copy.short_zh: 强调视觉不是背景视频，而是演出结构、屏幕尺度、声音节奏和现场气氛的一部分。

packages.title: Spatial Screens
packages.public_role: Ultra-wide screens, LED ring screens, spatial display composition, and large-format visual delivery.

copy.one_line_zh: 面向超宽屏幕、环幕、LED 空间和大型显示系统的空间影像包。
copy.short_zh: 用于说明 VIRTURA 如何把普通影像转化为适应屏幕尺度、空间观看和场地条件的视觉系统。

packages.title: Audiovisual Systems
packages.public_role: Audio curves, realtime visual systems, cue structure, Blender procedural workflow, and live audiovisual methods.

copy.one_line_zh: 面向声音、图像、材质、节奏和空间气氛协同组织的音画系统包。
copy.short_zh: AI 和音频处理不是为了自动生成画面，而是为了建立中间态分析、控制插件、演出工具和可复用的现场系统。

packages.title: Digital Exhibition
packages.public_role: MOVA, viewing rooms, online exhibition pages, public archive, and digital museum frontstage.

copy.one_line_zh: 面向线上展映、数字美术馆、作品观看室和公共档案的展映包。
copy.short_zh: 它负责把 GitHub 中的作品、图像、文字和记录转化为普通观众可以进入的公共观看路径。

packages.title: AI Production Tools
packages.public_role: AI-assisted tooling, intermediate analysis, audio processing, control plugins, and WorkspaceManager workflows.

copy.one_line_zh: 用于搭建分析、转码、音频处理、控制插件和团队工作流的 AI 辅助制作工具包。
copy.short_zh: AI 在这里不是廉价图像生成器，而是参与工具生产、项目整理、转码、分析、发布和现场系统维护的操作层。

packages.title: SpacePort App Frontstage
packages.public_role: iCloud-like app launcher and 2D frontstage for VIRTURA's creation network.

copy.one_line_zh: 把 SpacePort 从网页目录升级为应用化公众前台。
copy.short_zh: 它应该像一个 app launcher：打开后看到可进入的 station apps，而不是阅读普通网页 section。

packages.title: Guangzhou Expo Viewer Materials
packages.public_role: Public-safe materials from the Guangzhou exhibition viewer / Vision Pro / onsite demo pipeline.

copy.one_line_zh: 广州展会现场查看器与 Vision Pro 展示逻辑的素材包，待从本地导入。
copy.short_zh: 这些素材可以帮助团队说明：VIRTURA 不只做影像，也能把空间内容、网页查看器和设备观看逻辑打包成可演示的前台。
